name: University of Agder (UiA)
summary: Public university on Norway’s south coast; five English bachelor’s, from esports in Grimstad to English, development and music in Kristiansand.

handoff.label: How to apply to degree programmes (international)

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the entry requirement, and English at any grade that passes, SL or HL, covers English. The two music degrees add an entrance exam.

apply.via: Søknadsweb; Nordic citizens use Samordna opptak

dates.label: Music degrees: application deadline in Søknadsweb
Application web opens for EU/EEA and Nordic applicants
EU/EEA deadline: Academic Esports, English, Global Development Studies
Nordic citizens: Samordna opptak deadline for the same three
First results for EU/EEA applicants (second batch 10 July)

programmes.name: Classical Music Performance
programmes.ib: Audition on your main instrument plus aural and theory tests; a recorded audition and online tests are possible from abroad.

programmes.name: Electronic Music
programmes.ib: Entrance exam: 10–15 minutes of your own produced work plus a written statement by 15 January. The programme page says 1 March; the exam page says apply by 15 December.

programmes.name: English
programmes.ib: Asks for English beyond the one-year upper-secondary minimum.

notes: Academic Esports is taught mainly on the Grimstad campus; UiA says each class also has one day on the Kristiansand campus.
In 2026 every qualified Samordna opptak applicant to Academic Esports was offered a place.
Global Development Studies sets the fourth semester aside for exchange, with Erasmus+ grants available.
